name: Picture of You
source:
A woman finds herself inside a painting gifted to her by an acquaintance of the past, and remembers a past she'd tried to forget.

[From [url=https://atelierapricot.itch.io/picture-of-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名女子发现自己置身于一幅过去的熟人送给她的画作中，并记起了她试图忘记的过去。

[来自[url=https://atelierapricot.itch.io/picture-of-you]itch.io[/url]]
